_meta.description: Florida bathroom cost calculator inputs and multipliers. Planning only — not bids. Base dollar bands come from fl-cost-ranges.json (bathroom_remodel × size→scale).

disclaimer: Planning only — not a bid or contractor quote. These ranges are conceptual Florida planning bands for homeowner budgeting. They are not contractor-specific prices, guarantees, or formal estimates.
methodologyNote: Start from statewide Florida bathroom bands by bath type (powder / standard full / primary), then apply relative multipliers for remodel depth, layout change, and finish level. Multipliers are relative planning factors, not market quotes. Location (ZIP/city) is for contractor matching only and does not invent local prices.
floridaNotes: Florida humidity makes waterproofing and ventilation more than finish details — leaks and mold repairs often appear after demo.
Shower pans, wet-wall tile, and glass packages move cost faster than vanity swaps.
Accessibility updates (curbless showers, grab bars, clearances) can change layout even when the room stays the same size.
Permits and inspections vary by city and county; full guts and plumbing moves almost always need a permit.

sizeOptions.label: Powder / half bath
sizeOptions.description: No tub or shower — vanity, toilet, finishes
sizeOptions.proxyHint: Typically the smallest bathroom on the floor plan

sizeOptions.label: Standard full bath
sizeOptions.description: Guest or hall bath with tub or shower

sizeOptions.label: Primary / luxury bath
sizeOptions.description: Main suite — larger footprint and higher finish expectations
sizeOptions.proxyHint: Often dual vanity, larger shower, or spa-style layout

depthOptions.label: Cosmetic refresh
depthOptions.description: Fixtures, paint, limited tile — wet area mostly stays
depthOptions.explain: Refresh stays closer to a fixture-and-finish package when waterproofing is not rebuilt.

depthOptions.label: Full remodel
depthOptions.description: New finishes and wet area with layout mostly intact — most common path
depthOptions.explain: The baseline Florida bathroom band assumes a real wet-area update, not just paint.

depthOptions.label: Gut / reconfiguration
depthOptions.description: Strip, new waterproofing, possible plumbing and layout moves
depthOptions.explain: Full guts raise demo, waterproofing, permit, and finish coordination cost.

layoutOptions.label: Same footprint
layoutOptions.description: Toilet, vanity, and wet area stay put
layoutOptions.explain: Keeping fixture locations limits plumbing relocation and wet-wall rebuild.

layoutOptions.label: Move fixtures slightly
layoutOptions.description: Small shifts without a new wet wall
layoutOptions.explain: Limited fixture moves stay near the mid band when major drains stay.

layoutOptions.label: Move fixtures or walls
layoutOptions.description: New wet wall, tub-to-shower conversion with re-plumb, or room expansion
layoutOptions.explain: Relocating drains, expanding showers, or opening walls adds plumbing, waterproofing, and inspection work.

finishOptions.label: Standard
finishOptions.description: Stock vanity, mid tile, builder-grade glass
finishOptions.explain: Standard products pull the band down when waterproofing stays simple.

finishOptions.label: Mid
finishOptions.description: Better tile, solid vanity, framed or semi-frameless glass
finishOptions.explain: Mid-market tile and fixtures are the baseline for these bands.

finishOptions.label: Premium
finishOptions.description: Custom tile or stone, quality glass, higher fixture package
finishOptions.explain: Premium tile, glass, and fixtures move the high end faster than the low end.

education: Full shower rebuilds and waterproofing typically move a project beyond cosmetic range.
Plumbing relocation increases both dollars and schedule risk.
Primary bathrooms usually carry higher finish and layout expectations than powder rooms.
This tool does not invent contractor prices — get written bids from licensed Florida contractors.
